adjudication_note: Adversarial review of phase two, gap P3. Three concepts were matching text that contradicts their own definitions, and all three are the same shape the campaign has hit repeatedly: a surface owned by the wrong concept because the right one did not exist. `system.service` carries `domains: [software, infrastructure]` and means a software process — all 24 of its corpus matches are financial or legal services. `bolsa de valores` was attached to entity.securities, defined as `tradable financial instruments`, while the corpus says `A Bolsa de Valores é um mercado organizado e regulado` — it is the venue, not the instruments. `prestadores de serviços` bare was attached to the ESSENTIAL provider, a concept the material explicitly contrasts with `os demais prestadores de serviços`.

concepts.def: The organised and regulated venue where listed shares are traded, contrasted with the over-the-counter market.
Work performed for a fund or an investor under contract, or a good's counterpart in consumption.
Any party contracted to perform a service for a fund, essential or not.
